_comment: DUMMY PROJECTS — layout testing placeholders, not real client work. To add a real project: drop the image/video into public/assets/, then copy one object below and edit it. 'ratio' is a CSS aspect-ratio string used by the masonry grid. Set 'video' to null for image-only projects, or to { "src": ..., "poster": ... } for hover-preview videos.

projects.title: Monochrome Type Posters
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover for a monochrome typographic poster series
projects.description: A series of monochrome typographic posters exploring weight, spacing and rhythm. High-contrast layouts built around a single oversized letterform, balanced with thin structural lines and one electric accent.

projects.title: Coffee Brand Identity — Concept
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover showing a letter-based brand identity concept
projects.description: Concept brand identity for a small coffee stand: a bold wordmark, a secondary lockup and supporting marks, drawn to sit comfortably on cups, stickers and signage.

projects.title: Instagram Content Kit — Sample
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover showing a nine-tile social media grid
projects.description: A nine-tile sample kit showing how a feed stays consistent: fixed grid rhythm, alternating type tiles and product frames, all generated from one reusable template.

projects.title: Launch Carousel — Sample
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover showing a three-slide launch carousel frame
projects.description: Three-slide carousel sample for a product launch — hook, detail, call to action — designed for a clean read on a phone screen.

projects.title: Short-Form Reel Edit — Sample
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover showing a vertical video reel filmstrip
projects.description: Fast-paced vertical reel sample: punchy cuts, motion accents and on-screen timecode, edited for sound-off viewing. Hover the card to preview the clip.

projects.title: Event Recap Cut — Sample
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover showing a video editing timeline
projects.description: Timeline-style event recap sample: alternating wide and detail shots with simple transitions and a consistent grade across the whole cut.

projects.title: Street Series — 35MM (Sample)
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover for a near-monochrome street photography series
projects.description: Sample street photography series: overlapping frames and layered shadows, kept in near-monochrome so the composition leads the frame.

projects.title: Studio Product Shots — Sample
projects.coverAlt: Placeholder cover for a studio product photography setup
projects.description: Studio product sample: single light, plain backdrop and a centered pedestal — a quiet setup that keeps all attention on the object.
